_note: CH582F over USB, no probe. Hold BOOT (PB22) while plugging USB, then `mcu flash`. Copy to .mcu-profile.json (or /ch32-new-project CH582F). Makefile must set TARGET:=firmware and TARGET_MCU:=CH582F, and include ch32fun.mk.
hostTest: cmake -S . -B build-host -G Ninja -DHOST_TESTS=ON && cmake --build build-host && ctest --test-dir build-host --output-on-failure
debugServer: echo 'USB ISP has no debug server. Use a WCH-Link on SWD (enable it first: wchisp config enable-debug) or printf over USB (FUNCONF_USE_USBPRINTF).' && exit 1
